response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(CASE WHEN b.amount <> 0 THEN (b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount END) AS avg_overspend FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS overall_avg_remaining FROM ev) SELECT ev.status, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining, AVG(ev.avg_overspend) AS avg_overspend_rate, AVG(ev.avg_remaining) / (SELECT overall_avg_remaining FROM overall) AS remaining_ratio_to_overall FROM ev GROUP BY ev.status;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with amount = 0 (undefined overspend rate) are treated as missing for the overspend average, and amount is not integer-divided (multiplied by 1.0).

The overall denominator is the mean of event-level average remaining values across all events that have at least one matching budget line (events with no budget lines are excluded since they have no event-level value).
Events with a NULL status form their own group in the output.
